name: Takamiya Ema
source:
Maho’s only daughter, a genuine sheltered rich girl. Raised by her mother, she unconsciously looks down on ordinary people — though she doesn’t mean any harm. Clueless about romance and sexuality due to having barely interacted with the opposite sex.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/jouryutuma/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
